text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Train-guy.
Did you stay out of trouble over the break...? *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see... a former resident who left the dorm
sent me a letter."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You wrote me so many pages
that I ended up putting a ton of energy into my reply too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Writing double the pages was fine and all, but...
by the time I finished, dawn had arrived. *yawn*..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon spent so much time replying to messages
that she barely got any rest...
